request: Write the PR description from these notes.
input: branch fix/retry-cap. Bug: sync retried forever when the server returned 503, hammered the API, ticket SUP-2211, customer Acme saw 40k requests in an hour. Root cause: retry loop in sync/retry.ts had no max. Fix: cap at 5 attempts, backoff doubles from 1s, then stop and show 'Sync paused' in the status bar. 401 is not retried at all now (it was retried before, pointless). Changed files: sync/retry.ts, sync/status.ts, tests/retry.test.ts. Verify: npm test -- retry ; manual: set SYNC_FAKE_503=1 and watch it stop after 5. I spent a day chasing a red herring in the websocket layer first. Not in this PR: retry budget per account, will do later. Risk: users with flaky networks will see 'Sync paused' more often.
